metadata.description: Open-source Claude Code plugins. Small, self-contained hooks and skills that fix a concrete gap — MIT, no account or org required.

plugins.name: claudeignore-guard
plugins.description: Enforces `.claudeignore` — which Claude Code does not support natively — and merges your `.gitignore` in by default, so a repo that already guards its secrets is protected with no setup. Denials name the exact rule and how to override it. Context hygiene rather than a security boundary: it covers Read/Edit/Write/NotebookEdit, not Bash or Grep, so permissions.deny remains the real boundary for genuinely sensitive paths.
